transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I can’t seem to keep all the moving parts organized anymore. Between patent notes, workshop prep, gallery deadlines, and team decisions, I just start on whatever feels loudest at the time instead of what actually matters. It’s getting hard to manage.
Recently, have you felt like you need much less sleep than usual while still having plenty of energy?
No, I haven’t noticed needing less sleep than usual or having unusually high energy.
Did you experience similar difficulties with attention and organization when you were a child?

Yes. Looking back at grade school, teachers would say I was bright but spent a lot of time daydreaming. I’d finish assignments and then forget to turn them in, and I was always losing my homework folders—well before I was a teenager.
Do you find yourself constantly plagued by excessive worries about everyday matters that feel difficult to control?
I’m not sure I’d say I’m constantly worried about everyday things. I do get stressed when there’s a lot to manage, but it doesn’t feel like ongoing worry that I can’t control.
